whoWeAre.title: Who We Are
whoWeAre.description: We are a B2B technical partner specializing in electrical installations and photovoltaic systems. Founded in 2024, we support companies across Europe with safe, efficient, and high-quality solar solutions. Backed by a team with over 15 years of industry experience, we deliver reliable, results-driven projects that support the transition to clean, sustainable energy through advanced technology and professional execution.

hero.title: WHO WE ARE?
hero.description: A team you can rely on from planning to installation.

stats.description: We are a practical team delivering reliable electrical and energy solutions for homes and businesses, with passion for sustainability.

aboutUs.title: ABOUT US
aboutUs.description: Novaluxe was founded in early 2024 by Nicolai Cojocari with the aim of providing high-quality electrical and technical solutions for photovoltaic projects. The company was created in response to the need to reduce CO₂ emissions and accelerate the transition to an energy model based on clean and sustainable sources.

mission.title: OUR MISSION
mission.description: Our mission is to design and implement efficient, safe solar systems tailored to the needs of each project, always ensuring professional, results-oriented work. Novaluxe operates in the B2B sector, partnering with companies that require a reliable technical partner for electrical installations and photovoltaic system assembly.

global.title: AROUND THE WORLD
global.description: Although we are a Spanish company, we operate across Europe, contributing technical expertise and experience to projects of different scales. Our team consists of professionals with over 15 years of experience in the industry, enabling us to deliver robust and well-executed solutions.

values.title: Our values
values.description: In the medium and long term, our goal is to continue growing, strengthen our presence in the sector, and consistently offer advanced technology at a fair price.
